// comment: Cupcake nightly heartbeat cron job template. Copy to ~/.openclaw/cron/jobs.json or let cupcake-heartbeat-install.mjs manage it.

jobs.name: Cupcake Nightly Heartbeat
jobs.description: Nightly health ping, activity summary, and optional Telegram daily digest.

payload.message: [HEARTBEAT] Nightly health check. 1) Confirm you're online and note which LLM model you're using. 2) Summarize the last 24h from ~/.openclaw/logs/activity.jsonl: message count, active channels, any errors. 3) Append a heartbeat event to that log file. 4) If CUPCAKE_HEARTBEAT_TELEGRAM_ID is set, send a brief digest there. Keep it short, Cupcake-voice.
